absent_features.total_power: Total spectral power is not a column. The five absolute band powers already partition the in-band spectrum, so no summed column is added.
absent_features.skewness: Skewness was not extracted in Phase 2.
absent_features.kurtosis: Kurtosis was not extracted in Phase 2.
absent_features.hjorth_activity: Hjorth activity is the signal variance. That value is already stored as variance, and it is not duplicated under another name.
